note: Macon County TN has no queryable zoning district service. The county's 2014 zoning code PDF refers to an Official Zoning Map but does not include it; the county site links only that PDF. Red Boiling Springs publishes its zoning map as a PDF. ArcGIS searches for Macon County zoning returned nothing; the only county GIS link is the state TNMap parcel viewer, which shows no zoning districts. Lafayette's city maps page was a 404 and showed no zoning service.
